strength.label: Horsepower (HP) — Strength
strength.desc: Tracks DOTS-adjusted output. Higher = more peak HP per kg of chassis.

explosivePower.label: Torque (TRQ) — Explosive
explosivePower.desc: Tracks launch torque and kinetic discharge. Higher = sharper throttle response off the line.

cardio.label: Stint (STINT) — Cardio
cardio.desc: Tracks aerobic ceiling and heat management. Higher = longer stints at redline.

muscleMass.label: Chassis Build (CHSS) — Muscle
muscleMass.desc: Tracks SMM relative to height. Higher = fuller chassis profile and structural load capacity.

bodyFat.label: Power-to-Weight (P2W) — FFMI
bodyFat.desc: Tracks FFMI from body stats. Higher = denser lean mass and stronger power-to-weight.

gripStrength.label: Traction (GRIP) — Grip
gripStrength.desc: Tracks terminal neural grip output. Higher = stronger traction and limit control under load.
